sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Targets don't move on their own. They only move when I click green blocks.
# Move player back to col 26-27 (aligned with rightmost target), then click 1 green block to measure descent.
# Player at cols 44-45, need to go to 26-27: 18 LEFT moves
action(['LEFT']*18)
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='b':
        b=n['boundary']; cs=[x[1] for x in b]
        print("player cols", min(cs), max(cs))
# Now click 1 green block (top-left: row 25, col 13)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':25,'col':13}])
print("after 1 click: step", current_frame.step)
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='p' and min(x[0] for x in n['boundary'])<60:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[x[0] for x in b]; cs=[x[1] for x in b]
        print("purple rows",min(rs),max(rs),"cols",min(cs),max(cs))
ng=sum(1 for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
print("green count:",ng)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
